title: Pressured every day to withdraw the case
proves: Intimidation to withdraw the complaint is recognised, and long pauses and a strained voice support the reading.
summary: A caller says people come to the house every day telling her to take the case back. She speaks slowly with long pauses and has not slept properly for weeks.

steps.text: वो लोग रोज़ घर आते हैं। कहते हैं केस वापस ले लो, नहीं तो अच्छा नहीं होगा।
steps.gloss: Those people come to the house every day. They say take the case back, or it will not go well.

steps.text: कई हफ़्तों से मुझे रात को नींद नहीं आती। हर आहट पर लगता है कि वही लोग हैं।
steps.gloss: For several weeks I have not been able to sleep at night. At every sound I feel it is them.

steps.text: मुझे समझ नहीं आता कि मैं क्या करूँ।
steps.gloss: I do not understand what I should do.
